'''Pinac Galous''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] economic advisor. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he announced a fifteen percent rise in consumption tax, citing the rising cost of [[List of phrases and slang/Legends#R|rawmat]] costs and increasing [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] activity.
